name: yamakawa-code
description: A Claude Code–style chat sidebar for VS Code. Works with OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Ollama backends.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI / any OpenAI-compatible API (OhMyGPT, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI, Together, Azure OpenAI, etc.)
yamakawaCode.provider.description: Which AI provider to talk to. Adjust baseUrl and model accordingly.

yamakawaCode.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL for the API. Leave empty to use the default for the selected provider. Common values:
- OpenAI: `https://api.openai.com/v1`
- OhMyGPT: `https://apic1.ohmycdn.com/v1` *(default for `openai` provider)*
- DeepSeek: `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`
- Moonshot (Kimi): `https://api.moonshot.cn/v1`
- Groq: `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1`
- OpenRouter: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`
- xAI: `https://api.x.ai/v1`
- Anthropic: `https://api.anthropic.com` *(default for `anthropic`)*
- Gemini: `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com` *(default for `gemini`)*
- Ollama: `http://localhost:11434` *(default for `ollama`)*

yamakawaCode.model.description: Default model name used for chat completions.

yamakawaCode.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the selected provider. If empty, the extension reads (in order): `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OHMYGPT_API_KEY` (openai), `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (anthropic), `GEMINI_API_KEY` / `GOOGLE_API_KEY` (gemini). Not required for Ollama.

yamakawaCode.systemPrompt.default: You are Yamakawa Code, a concise, expert pair-programmer. Reply in the user's language. Use Markdown and fenced code blocks for code.
yamakawaCode.systemPrompt.description: System prompt used for every conversation.

yamakawaCode.workspaceTools.description: Allow the assistant to read, write, patch and delete files in the workspace via tool calls. Write/delete/patch always ask for confirmation.

yamakawaCode.theme.accent.description: Accent color (Claude-style warm coral). Any CSS color.

yamakawaCode.theme.background.description: Chat background color. Leave empty to follow VS Code sidebar background.

yamakawaCode.theme.foreground.description: Primary text color. Leave empty to follow VS Code foreground.

yamakawaCode.theme.muted.description: Muted / secondary text color. Leave empty for an automatic value.

yamakawaCode.theme.border.description: Border / divider color. Leave empty for an automatic value.

yamakawaCode.theme.fontFamily.description: Override the UI font (Claude.ai uses a Styrene-like sans). Example: 'Inter, system-ui'.

yamakawaCode.theme.fontSerif.description: Override the serif font used for AI replies (Claude.ai uses a Tiempos-like serif). Example: 'Charter, Georgia, serif'.

yamakawaCode.theme.fontMono.description: Override the monospace font used for code blocks. Example: 'JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, monospace'.

scripts.release:patch: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce publish patch
scripts.release:minor: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce publish minor
scripts.release:major: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce publish major
